article.title: Disease, defect, etc., not to disqualify.
article.content: No person shall be disqualified from succeeding to any property on the ground of any disease, defect or deformity, or save as provided in this Act, on any other ground whatsoever.
article.html:
28Disease, defect, etc., not to disqualify.

Section 28 · Chapter II · General provisions relating to succession · page 11 of the Act

No person shall be disqualified from succeeding to any property on the ground of any disease, defect or deformity, or save as provided in this Act, on any other ground whatsoever.
